The '''chambers''' of [[Burr Nolyds]], head of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]], were located in a [[Council Tower|villa]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[De-Purteen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]]. They were destroyed in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] along with Nolyds when a [[message disk]] left by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Executor]] [[Nom Anor]] [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructed]].
